The change in `wscbor.c` is because the lack of text encoding there was caught separately but not written as a separate issue ticket. The CBOR text strings are always UTF-8 encoding.

If `dissect_header_map` throws an exception (e.g., the fuzzed file in #19623), then `kty_key` is leaked.

changed this line in [version 5 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14438/diffs?diff_id=930966114&start_sha=4b35a2e73f108efff9bb5eed1206e2b69c25edd4#d7972f4bab6eb2ee3422745d5c6fda8d3f915c3d_876_884)

It's possible for `wsbcor_require_bstr` to return NULL, if `!wscbor_require_major_type(chunk, CBOR_TYPE_BYTESTRING)`.

You have to check if `val` is NULL before calling `tvb_utf_8_isprint(val, 0, -1)`. (Possibly that should check and return false in that case. Possibly there should be some more DISSECTOR_ASSERTs around passing in null tvbuffs.)

commits_data.message:
cose: Peek ahead for map principal value before dissecting map items

This change updates references to obsoleted RFCs and I-Ds,
provides human-readable interpretation of kid values, and fixes
the text encoding type in proto_tree_add_cbor_tstr().

Fixes #19659
